build_encoder_cuda_graph_manager: build an EncoderCudaGraphManager to capture and replay CUDA graphs for vision encoder budget-batch execution
create_budget_graph_metadata: create BudgetGraphMetadata dataclass holding token budget, batch sizes, CUDA graph, and input/output buffers for a single budget graph
capture_encoder_cuda_graphs: capture CUDA graphs for all configured token budgets in the encoder CUDA graph manager
execute_encoder_with_cuda_graphs: execute vision encoder using greedy-packed CUDA graphs with token budget-based batching and optional data-parallel sharding
get_cumulative_cuda_graph_stats: get cumulative CUDA graph statistics including hits, misses, and hit rate for the encoder graph manager
